answer: Every key must be answerable in court before it earns: name a registered company plus a custodian vault holding a signed standing lien, so liability has an inlet, not a pseudonym. Both issue off-ledger; no key mints its own backing. Bond 20x one epoch reward, cap three keys per entity, and turn collusion findings into arbitral awards the custodian executes in 14 days, no vote. One judgment sends a ripple through every key that entity backs, so a farm must fund a shell per head, near 100x per-epoch income yearly. It fails where shells dissolve untraced or custodians take self-signed liens.
